rules.summary: Applicant is a Timor-Leste citizen, proven by valid ID card (BI), voter card and RDTL birth certificate
rules.how_to_check: Check that the three documents exist and are valid (boolean)
rules.gap: Authenticity of documents is still checked by a person

rules.summary: Age at least 20 and at most 55 years
rules.how_to_check: Compute age from date of birth and compare with 20 and 55
rules.gap: Reference date (closing date? test date?) and whether limits are inclusive are not stated

rules.summary: Diploma at the required level and field, legalised by MESCC
rules.how_to_check: Level (Bacharelatu/Licenciatura) as a rule; field through a mapping list of study programmes
rules.gap: No mapping list of fields yet; legalisation is checked from the document; CPI/4 text is inconsistent

rules.summary: At least 3 months of work experience in the relevant field in a health facility
rules.how_to_check: Duration computed from start and end dates; field and type of facility need judgement
rules.input_needed: Work history in the CV (position, place, dates)
rules.gap: No experience letter in the document list; evidence is only the CV and certificates

rules.summary: Mastery of Tetum and Portuguese (official languages); minimum knowledge of English
rules.how_to_check: Cannot be coded from documents; assessed by test or interview
rules.gap: No threshold or test method stated; CPI/4 asks only minimum Portuguese and English

rules.summary: Good physical and mental condition, proven by a medical certificate at the interview stage
rules.how_to_check: Presence and validity of the certificate as a rule; medical content is outside the system
rules.gap: Required at interview stage, not at initial submission

rules.summary: Good conduct, proven by a valid "Bom Comportamento" certificate from the Ministry of Justice
rules.how_to_check: Check presence and validity period; content checked by a person
rules.gap: Not in the 9-item submission list; when it is submitted is unclear
Not in the 9-item submission list; when it is submitted is unclear

rules.summary: Complete submission (9 items) within 7-18 September 2026 (10 working days, working hours)
rules.how_to_check: Check completeness of the 9 items and the submission timestamp within the period
rules.input_needed: List of documents received, date and time
rules.gap: Period detected by OCR in 6 of 10 notices; the rest assumed the same

rules.summary: Three sequential stages: documents, written test, interview (eliminatory)
rules.how_to_check: State machine: continue only if the previous stage was passed
rules.gap: Pass rule for stage I is not described

rules.summary: Written test score of at least 60 to continue to the interview
Final score = simple arithmetic mean of all stage scores (0-100); suitable if >= 60
rules.how_to_check: Compute the mean and compare with 60
rules.gap: How stage I is scored is not explained; ranking against number of positions is not stated

rules.summary: Test content weights: general 25% and specific 75%
rules.how_to_check: Weight parameters on the test score (not a decision rule for candidates)
rules.gap: Question content is judged by people

rules.summary: Document assessment (stage I): criteria and how scores are given
rules.how_to_check: No written criteria, so it cannot be coded
rules.gap: Important gap for accountability and discretion; should be asked of CSC

institution_label: the Hospital Nacional Guido Valadares (HNGV), Ministry of Health, Timor-Leste
corpus_source_label: from the Civil Service Commission vacancy portal (vagas.cfp.gov.tl)
catalogue_intro: This catalogue lists the rules R01-R14 found in the ten HNGV vacancy notices of 2026 and whether each rule can be coded, partly coded, or needs human judgement.
catalogue_outro: All ten vacancy notices (CPI/1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 13, 14, 18, 22 of 2026) use the same template. They differ in job title, category, number of positions, salary, qualification and field of experience.
overview_text: Recruitment under the general career regime was suspended by Civil Service Commission circular 225/2025 of 17 April. The suspension does not cover the special career regime, which is why these notices could be published. The HNGV competition was approved by ministerial dispatch 684/GMS/IV/2026, and the jury composition was set by CFP dispatch 1020/2026/PCFP.
corpus_notes: The notice for vacancy {code} requires good physical and mental condition, proven by a medical certificate presented at the interview stage.
The good-conduct certificate and the professional card are not part of the numbered list of documents to submit, and the notice does not say when they are submitted.
The notice does not list an experience letter among the submitted documents, so experience is evidenced only by the CV and training certificates.
The notice does not describe a language test or a minimum score.

Documents for vacancy {code} are submitted over 10 working days. The candidate must show the original documents, and the copies are submitted in a coloured folder (the colour differs between notices: green in CPI/1, blue in CPI/2).
Candidates who pass the document selection continue to the written test, and candidates who pass the written test continue to the interview.
The final classification of vacancy {code} is the simple arithmetic mean of the scores of all selection stages.
General subjects of the written test for vacancy {code} include the Constitution of the RDTL, the history of Timor-Leste and the Public Service Statute legislation.
Specific subjects for vacancy {code} include the HNGV statute, the Organic Law of the Ministry of Health, the health professional career decree-laws and the specific area of {field}.

The list of candidates admitted after document assessment, written test, interview and the final result for vacancy {code} are published at hngv.ms.gov.tl/rekrutamentu, on the official HNGV Facebook page and on the Civil Service Commission website.
